findings.title: Importing the app with both flags exported rotates the live server's token
findings.evidence: HOME=$X D_SYSTEM_DEMO_TERMINAL=1 D_SYSTEM_TERMINAL_API=1 uv run pytest test/test_demo_terminal_api.py --co collected 111 tests and left $X/.d-system/terminal-api/0ebf5af3d99a3805.token; the test modules import src.api/src.main at module level before the build fixture sets a temporary HOME
findings.consequence: Running the suite or importing src.main in a shell that exports both flags overwrites the token file of a running server for the same checkout, which then answers 401 for the file's token
findings.minimal_fix: Clear D_SYSTEM_TERMINAL_API and set a temporary HOME before the module-level imports (conftest.py), or document that the flags must not be exported

findings.title: Tests do not pin the post-exit drain, append-before-send, or the frame reset of the ceiling
findings.evidence: Mutations: drain loop replaced by 'while False' -> 167 passed; send before append in the pump -> 167 passed; 'output.last_frame = time.monotonic()' replaced by pass -> 167 passed
findings.consequence: A regression in any of the three ADR-030 behaviours would not be caught
findings.minimal_fix: Add a websocket-level test that a frame resets the ceiling clock, one that checks ring content when the send raises, and one that holds the pump while the shell exits

findings.title: New mypy unused-ignore error in test_demo_terminal_api.py
findings.evidence: mypy: test/test_demo_terminal_api.py:845: error: Unused "type: ignore" comment [unused-ignore]; CI runs mypy src/ only, which passes
findings.consequence: Type check of the test file is not clean; CI gate unaffected
findings.minimal_fix: Remove the type: ignore[arg-type] comment at line 845

findings.title: wait and after grammar narrower than the ADR validation table
findings.evidence: Live: wait=.5, wait=1e1, wait=+1 return 422; after longer than 18 digits is refused
findings.consequence: A client sending an otherwise valid finite number in those forms is refused
findings.minimal_fix: Parse with float() plus isfinite and range checks, or document the narrower grammar in the ADR
